slides.title: Max Yasgur's Benediction
slides.body: Max Yasgur addresses the crowd from the farm that became Woodstock’s temporary home.

slides.title: What you are watching
slides.body: The recording is a public address from the landowner whose farm held the festival. Its value is direct and situational: the audience hears a host trying to speak to an enormous gathering at the point where event, community, and responsibility meet.
